text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of eribulin mesylate has been reported at approximately 4 times the recommended dose, which resulted in Grade 3 neutropenia lasting seven days and a Grade 3 hypersensitivity reaction lasting one day. There is no known antidote for eribulin mesylate overdose.

10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of Eribulin Mesylate Injection has been reported at approximately 4 times the recommended dose, which resulted in Grade 3 neutropenia lasting seven days and a Grade 3 hypersensitivity reaction lasting one day. There is no known antidote for Eribulin Mesylate Injection overdose.
